summary: Svtis waterfall between the Wasurna valley and the Chikhalda pocket. A small monsoon drop that extends the south-western loop by one stop.
description:
Svtis marks a monsoon fall in the country between the Wasurna valley and the Chikhalda–Ritu pocket, south-west of Ahwa. The name confirmed by a traveller who has visited, even if it appears nowhere in writing beyond its map pin.

Practically it extends the south-western loop by one stop: same village roads, same season, same carry-everything terms.
highlights: Extends the south-western falls loop by one stop
Between the Wasurna valley and the Chikhalda pocket

modes.road: Village roads south-west from Ahwa toward the Wasurna side
modes.rail: Waghai (heritage narrow gauge); Bilimora Jn for broad gauge

access.last_mile: Short walk from the road end

experience.photography_notes: Small falls, frame tight with the forest.

warnings: Wet rock is slick, grip footwear

tips: Fold into the Wasurna–Chikhalda–Baaj south-western loop
